title: Slovakian Paella
description: A nourishing Slovakian-inspired paella dish, perfect for a family dinner.

ingredients.name: Slovakian sausage
ingredients.notes: you can use kielbasa or another type of sausage

ingredients.name: Onions
ingredients.notes: you can use red or yellow onions

ingredients.name: Chicken broth
ingredients.notes: you can use vegetable broth instead

instructions: Heat oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add Slovakian sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove sausage from the pan and set aside.
Add mixed bell peppers and onions to the pan, cooking until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add paella rice and stir to coat with oil and mix with vegetables.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add chicken broth, thyme, and paprika. Stir to combine.
Return sausage to the pan and season with salt.
Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed, about 20-25 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
